english_translations.sahih_international: The angels and the Spirit descend therein by permission of their Lord for every matter.
english_translations.pickthall: The angels and the Spirit descend therein, by the permission of their Lord, with all decrees.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: Therein come down the angels and the Spirit by Allah's permission, on every errand:
english_translations.shakir: The angels and Jibreel descend in it by the permission of their Lord for every affair,
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: On this Night, the angels and the spirit descend by the permission of their Lord with His decree (to determine everyone's destiny).
english_translations.mohsin_khan: Therein descend the angels and the Ruh [Jibrael (Gabriel)] by Allah's Permission with all Decrees,
english_translations.arberry: in it the angels and the Spirit descend, by the leave of their Lord, upon every command.

ayahs.translation_bn: (এ রাতে বিরাজ করে) শান্তি আর শান্তি- ফজর উদয় হওয়া পর্যন্ত।
ayahs.translation_en: Peace it is until the emergence of dawn.
ayahs.conventional_en: Peace it is until the emergence of dawn.

english_translations.sahih_international: Peace it is until the emergence of dawn.
english_translations.pickthall: (The night is) Peace until the rising of the dawn.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: Peace!... This until the rise of morn!
english_translations.shakir: Peace! it is till the break of the morning.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: This Night is all peace until the break of dawn.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: Peace! (All that night, there is Peace and Goodness from Allah to His believing slaves) until the appearance of dawn.
english_translations.arberry: Peace it is, till the rising of dawn.
